attempts.summary: Created opsbot on node1 and node2 (both locked-password accounts), generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1, installed the public key in opsbot's authorized_keys on node2, and enforced key-only SSH (sshd_config Match User opsbot: PasswordAuthentication no, AuthenticationMethods publickey) on both nodes. Verified opsbot@node1 can run commands on node2 over key auth and that password auth is explicitly rejected on both systems. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol for node1 and node2, confirming changed boot_id on each and that the opsbot account, keys, sshd config, and cross-node key-based SSH access all survived and re-verified after both restarts.
